in_sanskrit.name: Tulu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Rock, hill
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Tulu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'tula' which means 'rock, hill'. It symbolizes strength and stability, evoking a sense of calmness and peace. In Tulu language, it is also a name for the Tulu people.
